name: Pininyahang Manok
author: JezCruz on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 1 lb chicken, cut into serving pieces
1 cup evaporated milk (optional for creamy version)

steps: Heat cooking oil in a pan and sauté onions and garlic until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Pour fish sauce and stir for a minute.
Add pineapple juice and simmer for 15–20 minutes until the chicken becomes tender.
Add carrots and pineapple chunks, then continue cooking until vegetables soften.
Pour evaporated milk for a creamy texture (optional).
Add bell peppers and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for another 3–5 minutes and serve hot.
